title: ornithopus × macrorrhynchus
intro: Ornithopus × macrorrhynchus, commonly known as the hybrid white bird's foot trefoil, is a perennial legume plant that is native to Australia and New Zealand. The health benefits of Ornithopus × macrorrhynchus include its potential to support digestive health and its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ornithopus × macrorrhynchus include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
